t: You're at River House Montessori School, a school in Tower Hamlets. The Montessori in its name points to Maria Montessori, an Italian physician and educator. She began as a student hoping to become an engineer, then changed course and entered medical school at the Sapienza University of Rome, graduating with honors in 1896. Her philosophy of education is now used globally, in many public and private schools, and it is the approach this school is named for.
